description_en: Queries scaling activities. You can call the DescribeScalingActivities operation to query the results of scaling activities triggered by scheduled tasks, event-triggered tasks, or manual execution of scaling rules. For example, you can query the status and cause of a scaling activity. You can also query the total number of instances after a scaling activity is complete
description_zh: 通过API DescribeScalingActivities查看伸缩活动的详情，了解通过定时任务、报警任务或手动执行伸缩规则等方式触发伸缩活动的结果。例如，您可以在伸缩活动详情页查看到伸缩活动的状态、活动起因、变化后总实例数等信息
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-scaling-activities --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --status-code Successful --scaling-activity-ids asa-bp161xudmuxdzofe0000 --instance-refresh-task-id ir-a12ds234fasd00000 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeScalingActivities

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scaling activity that you want to query belongs
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩活动所属伸缩组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scaling group.

When you call this operation, you must specify one of the following parameters: `ScalingGroupId` and `ScalingActivityIds`. You cannot specify both of them at the same time. If you specify neither of them, an error is reported
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组的ID。

调用该API时，`ScalingGroupId`和`ScalingActivityIds`参数必须二选一进行配置，如果两个参数同时都不配置，则会报错
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the scaling activity. Valid values:

Successful: The scaling activity is successful.
Warning: The scaling activity is partially successful.
Failed: The scaling activity failed.
InProgress: The scaling activity is in progress.
Rejected: The request to trigger the scaling activity is rejected
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动的状态。取值范围：
 
Successful：执行成功的伸缩活动。 
Warning：部分执行成功的伸缩活动。 
Failed：执行失败的伸缩活动。 
InProgress：正在执行的伸缩活动。 
Rejected：执行伸缩活动请求被拒绝。
parameters.name: status_code

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the scaling activities that you want to query.

When you call this operation, you must specify one of the following parameters: `ScalingGroupId` and `ScalingActivityIds`. You cannot specify both of them at the same time. If you specify neither of them, an error is reported
parameters.help_zh:
待查询伸缩活动的ID。

调用该API时，`ScalingGroupId`和`ScalingActivityIds`参数必须二选一进行配置，如果两个参数同时都不配置，则会报错
parameters.name: scaling_activity_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance refresh task. If you specify this parameter, this operation returns the list of scaling activities associated with the instance refresh task
parameters.help_zh: 实例刷新任务ID，可以设置此参数查询实例刷新任务相关的伸缩活动列表
parameters.name: instance_refresh_task_id

Indicates whether all lifecycle hooks are disabled when the scaling activity is triggered. Valid values:

true
false

伸缩活动是否禁用所有生命周期挂钩。可能值：

true：禁用。
false：不禁用

IgnoredLifecycleHookIds.description_zh: 伸缩活动禁用的生命周期挂钩ID列表

ScalingInstanceNumber.description_en:
If you query a scale-out activity, the value of this parameter indicates the number of instances that are created or the number of instances that are started from Economical Mode.
If you query a scale-in activity, the value of this parameter indicates the number of instances that are deleted or the number of instances that are stopped in Economical Mode
ScalingInstanceNumber.description_zh:
如果伸缩活动类型为扩容，该参数表示本次伸缩活动中被创建或从停机回收状态启动的实例的个数。

如果伸缩活动类型为缩容，该参数表示本次伸缩活动中被删除或进入停机回收状态的实例的个数

StartTime.description_en: The time when the scaling activity was started

StartedCapacity.description_en: The number of instances that are started from the Economical Mode during the scale-out event
StartedCapacity.description_zh: 当前伸缩活动从停机不收费状态启动的实例数量

StartedInstances.description_en: The instances that are started from the Economical Mode during the scale-out event
StartedInstances.description_zh: 当前伸缩活动启动的停机不收费实例列表

items.description_zh: 当前伸缩活动启动的停机不收费实例列表

Warning: The scaling activity is partially successful.

伸缩活动的状态，可能值：
 
Successful：执行成功的伸缩活动。

StatusMessage.description_en: The status message of the scaling activity

StoppedCapacity.description_zh: 当前伸缩活动进入停机不收费状态的实例数量

StoppedInstances.description_en: The instances that are stopped in the Economical Mode during the scale-in event
StoppedInstances.description_zh: 当前伸缩活动进入停机不收费状态实例列表

items.description_zh: 当前伸缩活动进入停机不收费状态实例列表

TotalCapacity.description_en: The total number of instances in the scaling group after the scaling activity was complete
TotalCapacity.description_zh: 执行完伸缩活动后，伸缩组中实例的总数

TriggerSourceId.description_en:
The ID of the trigger source of the scaling activity. Valid values:

If the scaling activity is triggered by an event-triggered task, the ID of the trigger source is the ID of the event-triggered task.
If the scaling activity is triggered by calling an API operation, the ID of the trigger source is the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account or Resource Access Management (RAM) user that you use to call the API operation.
If the scaling activity is triggered by Auto Scaling, the ID of the trigger source is null
TriggerSourceId.description_zh:
伸缩活动触发源ID。可能值：
Cms触发源ID：显示为报警任务ID。
Api触发源ID：显示为主账号UID或子账号UID。
Ess触发源ID：显示为空

TriggerSourceType.description_en:
The type of the trigger source of the scaling activity. Valid values:

Cms: The scaling activity is triggered by an event-triggered task.
APIs: The scaling activity is triggered by calling an API operation.
Ess: The scaling activity is triggered by Auto Scaling
TriggerSourceType.description_zh:
伸缩活动触发源类型。可能值：
Cms：通过报警任务触发伸缩活动。
Api：用户通过API方式触发伸缩活动。
Ess：系统任务触发伸缩活动

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of scaling activities
